summary.intent: Remove the Claude attribution footer from PR bodies generated by the /ship command, and clean up an already-created PR (#616) to match.
summary.outcome: Edited .claude/commands/ship.md to drop the attribution footer, recorded the new convention in project memory, indexed it in MEMORY.md, committed and pushed the change, and patched PR #616's existing body to strip the footer.

repo: CI on the cipher-box repo went fully green on the previous head before this session's changes were made.
workflow: The /ship command template (.claude/commands/ship.md) controls PR body formatting, including whether a Claude/Anthropic attribution footer is appended — this is a repo-level convention, not a global default.
Existing PRs need to be manually patched (via gh) after changing a template, since template edits don't retroactively affect already-created PR bodies.

open_items: Verify no other open PRs besides #616 still carry the old attribution footer and need the same patch.
